At 0-11, Siena had the odds stacked against them. But they gave the Blue Devils their best shot. Duke got a major scare in the 71-65 win. Duke came in as one of the strongest teams in the nation and top-overall seed in the field of 68. They didn't look that way in the first half. Cam Boozer had a double-double with 22 points and 13 rebounds. Here is a look at the box score from Thursday's first round East Region game in Greenville.
